notes: Stimhacks an unprotected R&D and then runs it four times a turn, seeing the same top card, until broke at 0 credits; later clicks for credits for turns while the Corp scores three agendas from a remote it contests only once, with tag-losing IP Block runs.

Leaving R&D unprotected on turn 1 gives up two early agendas and there are a couple of idle credit clicks while rich, but it then builds a coherent Bankers economy, scores from the remote and finishes with SanSan for a fast close.

Aggressive and effective early pressure punishes unrezzed ice for a turn-5 win, correctly declines Obokata when it would flatline; runs on low credits and repeated HQ hits on a small hand are minor inefficiencies.

Good Snare traps and a clean Data Raven into Scorched Earth kill, but it installed Priority Requisition behind ice it never rezzed despite 10 credits and gave it away, and an Account Siphon later left it at 1 credit.

Wins eventually against a passive Corp, but it is slow: many idle credit turns when a cheap HQ run was always available, plus Stimhack wasted on a 1-credit HQ run and on an Archives run, taking core damage each time.
Plays Hard-Hitting News twice with no follow-up, then burns its credits trashing resources, which leaves it broke and unable to rez the R&D ice, so the Runner walks into R&D for most of its points.
Excellent tempo: an early Account Siphon, Forged Activation Orders to trash the R&D ice and later to force a 10-credit rez, steady central pressure and a timely remote run for a turn-6 win.

Makes four single-access R&D runs a turn that see the same card, never contests the remotes, then clicks for credits for six turns, climbing to 31 credits, while the Corp scores out from barely-iced servers.

Scores steadily from an iced remote, but plays Biotic Labor just to click for credits, clicks for credits and discards for many turns, and lets an agenda reach unprotected Archives, where it is stolen.
Clean, efficient agenda play: an SDS behind Mausolus, back-to-back Hostile Takeovers for money and a second SDS for a turn-9 win; it left HQ briefly open on turn 1 and was cash-tight mid-game.
Its IP Block remote scores reliably, but R&D stayed unprotected until turn 4 and HQ until turn 9, giving up GFI and AR-Enhanced Security, and Hard-Hitting News was never followed up.

Twice facechecks the same Afshar while poor, then spends about 15 turns on economy and empty Archives runs while HQ holds agendas, wastes Stimhacks on Archives, and fails to contest the final game-winning remote despite 31 credits.
Simple, effective scoring from a single iced remote on a tight budget; there are some idle credit clicks while discarding, but nothing costly.

Repeats single-access R&D runs, runs Marilyn Campaign four times without trashing it, then clicks for credits up to 32 while the Corp installs and scores two GFIs from lightly iced remotes it never runs.

Strong HQ pressure with Temujin and Dirty Laundry and a clever Film Critic finish; a deep remote run with no killer cost a Cloak and two cards to Cobra, and it was spent hosting a 1-point Breaking News.

Leaves R&D unprotected for 12 turns while clicking for credits on 20+ credits and never installing an agenda, puts Dedication Ceremony counters on a campaign, then spends all its money trashing resources down to 0 and loses to R&D steals.

The Data Leak Reversal mill into open Archives is a clever, coherent win, but Joshua B. plus paying every turn to clear its tag is a net loss, and it sat on 15-21 credits for many turns while the Corp was broke.

Plays Divert Power with nothing to use it on, leaves its HQ and R&D ice unrezzed so Send a Message is stolen from HQ, puts Regolith in an open remote, and idles; the final Obokata in a 3-ice remote was reasonable but lost to Mad Dash.

Scores efficiently from one remote and wins, but leaves R&D open until turn 5 and HQ until turn 7, and wastes tags from Breaking News and Hard-Hitting News on a 1-credit Closed Accounts and a do-nothing Exchange of Information.
Never runs HQ or R&D all game and clicks for credits up to 24 for many turns while the Corp scores three agendas from remotes; its single remote attempt bounces off Ice Wall with no fracter.
